spec.name: Wayside Shrine of the Wind
spec.description: A Genshin Impact style roadside shrine: a vermilion torii gate, a small stone-based wooden hokora shrine with offerings, stone lanterns and hanging paper lanterns, built as a stylized low-poly prop group.
spec.layout: Static prop group on a small stone plinth footprint. Front (+Z): a vermilion torii gate (two round pillars, kasagi top beam with upswept black ends, nuki tie beam, central plaque with gold emblem) at z=1.6. A flagstone path runs from the torii back to the shrine. Two stone toro lanterns flank the path at z=0.5 (x=+/-1.1), each with a glowing warm window. Behind at z=-1.2 stands the hokora: a stone base with steps, a wooden box with a double door, a teal-tiled hip roof with gold finials and a hanging shimeNawa rope with white paper shide. In front of the shrine steps sit offerings: a small wooden offering box with coin slot, sake bottle, fruit plate, a stack of mora coins, flowers in a vase. Two paper lanterns hang from the torii nuki and glow orange. Genshin look: clean saturated colours, warm vermilion against teal and cream, gold trim lines, cyan glowing anemo crystal floating above the shrine roof, small fabric ribbons with gold tassels. Bold chunky primitive shapes, details as small parts in their own colours.

parts.builds: Torii gate at z=1.6: two round tapered vermilion pillars (radius 0.17 at base, 0.14 top, height 2.9) on black lacquer base rings and stone footings; curved kasagi top beam (vermilion with black lacquer cap slab and upswept ends), shimaki below it, nuki tie beam through pillars with protruding ends, central gakuzuka plaque in blackLacquer with a gold emblem (small gold diamond plus ring), gold bands where beams meet pillars, and two hanging paper lanterns (paper colour with glowWarm emissive, ink stripes, gold caps and tassels) from the nuki at x=+/-0.8. Pillar span 3.0 m between centres (x=+/-1.5).
parts.attaches: Stands on ground at toriiCenter; path begins at pathStart just behind it.

parts.builds: Flagstone path from z=1.3 to z=-0.6 made of irregular stone slabs in stone/stoneLight with moss tufts at edges; low grass-moss border patches; two stone toro lanterns at lanternL and lanternR: stepped hex base, tapered post with ring, hex firebox with glowing glowWarm windows on the path-facing sides, wide hex roof with upturned corners in stoneDark, gem-shaped finial (hoju) in stoneLight, moss on roof tops.
parts.attaches: Path meets torii at pathStart and shrine steps at offeringArea; lanterns stand on ground at lanternL/lanternR.

parts.builds: Hokora small shrine centred at shrineBase (width 1.6, depth 1.3): two-tier stone plinth with front steps (3 steps) toward +Z, wooden raised veranda with woodDark posts and railing, wooden cabin walls (wood with woodDark framing beams), a double door in vermilionDark with gold studs and gold handles and a central gold emblem, small side windows with lattice, and gold trim along the base line. Cream cloth banners hang left and right of door.
parts.attaches: Plinth on ground at shrineBase; roof sits on shrineRoofBase; steps end at offeringArea.

parts.builds: Hip roof from shrineRoofBase upward: wide overhanging eaves in roofTeal with curved upswept corners, layered tile rows as thin ridge strips in roofTealDark, gold ridge cap and gold fish-shaped finials (onigawara) at both ridge ends, gold trim along the eaves edge, woodDark rafter ends underneath, a hanging shimeNawa rope of rope colour across the front with cream paper shide zigzags and small gold bells, and a floating anemo crystal at crystal mount: faceted double-pyramid in anemo glowing, with three small orbiting shards and a ring of tiny swirl leaf shapes in leaf colour.
parts.attaches: Rests on shrineBody at shrineRoofBase (y=1.75); crystal floats at crystal mount.

parts.builds: Offerings in front of the shrine steps around offeringArea (z from -0.1 to 0.3): wooden saisen offering box (wood with woodDark slats, slotted top, gold trim, red rope bell cord with gold bell hanging from a small post), a plate of fruit (apples in apple, oranges in orange, small leaf parts) on a cream dish, a sake bottle with sake colour and cream label with ink mark, two sake cups, stack of gold mora coins with a hole detail, a small vase with flowerPink blooms and leaf stems, two candles with glowWarm flames, and a few scattered paper cranes in cream and red.
parts.attaches: Sits on ground or the lowest shrine step at offeringArea; between lanterns and the shrine steps.

calls.reasoning:
I'm checking the box's z-boundaries against where the steps and plinth actually land, since my current placement is pushing the steps outside the valid range — I need to shift the local z positions so everything stays within the box limits.

I'm reworking the step geometry to fit within the 0.7 local z cutoff: shrinking each step's depth and staggering their centers so the tallest step sits closest to the plinth and the front edge of the last step lands right at the boundary. Overlap between steps and the plinth front is acceptable here, so I'm moving on to sizing the cheek blocks next.

I see the shimenawa rope placement is out of bounds, sagging below y0 and exceeding the box's z and x limits. I need to reposition it so the rope stays at y>=1.75 and within the box's x and z constraints, adjusting the roof overhang scale accordingly.

I'm recalculating the rope's z-offset to pull it inward within bounds, and adjusting the rope's vertical anchor point plus the shide hang offsets so their lowest edges stay above the minimum y threshold.

Now checking the eave overhang's x/z extent after the 45-degree rotation—the corner boxes and cones are poking past the back boundary, so I'm scaling their offsets down (corners ×1.15, z ×0.85, cones to 1.25) to keep everything inside the frame.

Checking crystal height at cy=3.3 gives top 3.72, slightly over the 3.6 limit, so I'll lower cy closer to the query y to bring the top to around 3.52 while keeping the bottom clear at 3.1-0.3. Need to adjust the orbit leaves to match the new cy too.
